Thanks for contributing! Please fill out the relevant sections below.
For node additions, the checklist in CONTRIBUTING.md is the authoritative one.
-->

## Type of change

- [ ] New atomic node
- [ ] Update existing node (correction / addition)
- [ ] New gotcha (one-liner appended to `meta/gotchas.md`)
- [ ] New theme folder + MOC
- [ ] Docs / scaffolding (README, AGENTS, CI, etc.)
- [ ] Security fix (see SECURITY.md)

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences. What changed and why. -->

## Checklist (for new/changed nodes)

- [ ] Node is in the right `references/<theme>/` folder.
- [ ] Frontmatter has `title`, `summary`, `tags`.
- [ ] Node is 40–80 lines.
- [ ] Source cited at the bottom.
- [ ] Wikilinks use `[[bare-name]]` (no path, no `.md`).
- [ ] The relevant `MOC-<theme>.md` has been updated to include this node.
- [ ] Ends with a `## Gotcha` section.
- [ ] If `SKILL.md` description changed: tested against 3+ positive and 2+ negative queries on at least two model families (see CONTRIBUTING.md → Cross-model checks).
